notes.title: The Past Within - Update 7.8.0.0
notes.content:
To celebrate our 9-year anniversary as Rusty Lake, we’ve added a connection between Underground Blossom and The Past Within in the form of a secret mini-game. Check out our social platforms to see how to establish a connection between The Past and The Future and unlock this secret mini-game in The Past Within.
 

 [b]Patch Notes 7.8.0.0[/b]
 

 [list]
 [*]  New secret: A secret mini-game that can be accessed through information found in the latest Underground Blossom update!
 [*]  Small bug fixes
 [/list]
 

 Thank you for your support!

notes.title: The Past Within is 50% OFF as part of Steam Puzzle Fest 🌸 New Game Announced 🚇
notes.content:
[h3]The Past Within is part of Steam Puzzle Fest!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691524/56dac1d911507540b66199cc798cc953c95b625f.png[/img]
This week marks 8 years together as Rusty Lake! And, of course, we have to celebrate this incredible anniversary with several announcements, including a big reveal. 

A part of our anniversary celebrations is being part of Steam Puzzle Fest! You can now grab The Past Within, as well as all our other Rusty Lake premium titles, for 50% OFF from today until May 1st! 

[h3]New Game in the Rusty Lake Universe
[/h3]
[previewyoutube=7I8eBrH7Azk;full][/previewyoutube]
📣 Next stop in the Rusty Lake universe: Underground Blossom! 🚇 🌸

We’re happy to finally share a first look at our upcoming project, Underground Blossom! Descend into the Rusty Lake Underground and travel through the life and memories of Laura Vanderboom! 

All aboard the [b]Underground Blossom Demo - now available to play on Steam![/b] Don’t forget to wishlist Underground Blossom to secure a ticket! 🎟️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2291850/Underground_Blossom/

The full experience will arrive later this year on mobile (iOS / Android) and PC! 🛤️

notes.title: The Past Within - Update 7.6.0.1
notes.content:
Spring is officially here and with it, we bring you new patch notes in our 5th update for The Past Within and some small news to go with it all!

First of all, we’d like to thank everyone who joined our official [url=https://discord.gg/rustylake]Rusty Lake Discord[/url]! We’re now at over 200k users and we’re just blown away by how many people we see playing The Past Within in our Voice Cube channels, sharing theories, fan arts, Rusty Lake memes and more!

And just another big thank you to everyone who tried our co-op experience! If you haven’t yet and are curious to play it with a friend or someone from our aforementioned Discord, now is the perfect time to do so! The Past Within, together with the rest of our Rusty Lake catalogue of games, is 40% off as part of the Steam Spring Sale. The sale lasts until March 23rd!

And now back to the patch notes for The Past Within!

[b]Patch Notes 7.6.0.1[/b]
[list][*] Fixed several save game related crashes
[*] Fixed Steam Achievements not unlocking properly
[*] Fixed a crash with Arabic device languages
[*] Fixed localization issue in main menu
[*] Fixed localization issue in credits
[*] Added TikTok icon
[*] Added Ukrainian and Finnish language support
[/list]
We hope you’ll enjoy Update no.5! Have a great week and a fantastic spring! 

* Thanks for your support! Feel free to reach out if you want to help us translating the game to more languages.

notes.title: The Past Within - Update 7.3.0.0
notes.content:
This is our third update for The Past Within! Thank you all for playing the game over the past two weeks. It means a lot to us to read so many positive reviews. Please check out more on our next live stream and patch notes below.

We've heard rumours again about the MemoryCube_recording_03152 being broadcast today at 17:00 CET on our [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFHNBcZS1wQsI_Fk1q-j1wx72kQXDmmiQ]Youtube channel[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515210/The_Past_Within/]Steam page[/url]. Are you ready to start searching for the 4th scroll?

In case you do run into any issues, please reach out to us on our [url=https://discord.gg/dV4NjBFQNd]Discord help channel[/url]. It's the best place to receive help and the quickest way for us to get started on a fix!

[list][*] Fixed soup related save game issues in Chapter 1 The Past
[*] Fixed paintings not being clickable in Chapter 1 The Past
[*] Fixed setting time not progressing the game in Chapter 1 The Past
[*] Fixed crash after blood pump in Chapter 2 The Past[/list]

notes.title: The Past Within - Update 7.2.1.0
notes.content:
Today, we bring you our second update for The Past Within! Thank you all for playing the game this weekend. Many of you have been watching the great stream from [url=https://www.twitch.tv/elraenn]Elraenn[/url]. It's been amazing to see all the 2-player voice channels in our Discord being used by players to make new connections! 

Before we get to the actual patch notes, we've heard rumors about the MemoryCube_recording_02932 being broadcasted tomorrow at 16:00 CET on our [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFHNBcZS1wQsI_Fk1q-j1wx72kQXDmmiQ]Youtube channel[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515210/The_Past_Within/]Steam page[/url]. Don't forget to miss it if you're craving some more puzzles!

In case you do run into any issues, please reach out to us in the [url=https://discord.gg/dV4NjBFQNd]Discord help channel[/url]. It's the best place to receive help and the quickest way for us to get started on a fix!

[*] Fixed smoke not going away in Chapter 1 The Past
[*] Fixed 3rd fuse not showing up in Chapter 1 The Future

notes.title: The Past Within - Patch Notes 7.1.0.0
notes.content:
Over the past two days, we’ve received an overwhelming amount of feedback and appreciation for our latest game. We’re working hard to respond to everyone and address the issues that some of you have found. With today's update, we bring you an even smoother version of The Past Within! In the patch notes below you can read more about what we’ve improved.

If you haven’t left a review yet, please consider taking a moment to share your experience with us. We couldn’t do this without your invaluable help!

Oh and if you’ve been wondering what’s going on with those mysterious broadcasts on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1515210/allnews/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFHNBcZS1wQsI_Fk1q-j1wx72kQXDmmiQ]Youtube[/url], a lot of people have been puzzling together with the contents of these videos in our [url=https://discord.gg/rustylake]Discord[/url]! If you’re curious to learn more or get involved with the theory-crafting, we hope to see you there soon.

[b]Patch Notes 7.1.0.0[/b]
[list]
[*]Laptops with touch screens are now supported
[*]Low Quality is now supporting more low-end devices
[*]Fixed clock snapping back to certain hours Chapter 1 The Past
[*]Fixed stuck peek hole sliders Chapter 1 The Future
[*]Fixed crash when loading the next chapter
[*]Fixed crash after red emergency lever Chapter 1 The Future[/list]
